content:
The wait between the first two seasons of "Severance" has already been long enough, and the third season is testing viewers' patience just as much — though Apple TV+ has just announced a major update on the series.

"Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming and is expected to premiere in late 2027

It's been over 18 months since "Severance" Season 2 aired. Although the progress of Season 3 may not be as fast as everyone would like, it has just reached an important milestone.

According to a post shared by Ben Stiller on X and reposted by the official Apple TV+ account, "Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming.

A low-resolution behind-the-scenes photo shared by Stiller appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running down a Lumon corridor, reminiscent of the iconic scene from the Season 2 finale.

In the Season 2 finale, Mark makes a shocking decision to stay with Helly, defying his "outie"'s original plan to reunite with Gemma, setting the stage for a tense and thrilling Season 3 storyline.

There was a three-year gap between "Severance" Seasons 1 and 2, due to reasons including script revisions, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If Season 3 requires 6 to 9 months of filming, plus 6 months of post-production, "Severance" will most likely return in autumn 2027 — roughly three years after the previous season.

When do you expect "Severance" Season 3 to premiere? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.

Apple TV+ monthly subscription is priced at US$12.99, with discount offers available when bundled through Apple One.
